theorems.name: Submission.dorag_th_trace_proj_comp_compl
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ T = Module.finrank ℝ S → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - S.starProjection).toLinearMap) = 1 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin P, ‖T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
